name: newcastle-core-v1
description: Initial Newcastle city-centre extraction area for TYNE CITY.
notes: Initial core covers central Newcastle, Monument, Haymarket, Central Station and the Quayside/Tyne Bridge approach.
Gateshead-side expansion is not included in this initial extraction boundary.
The bounding box is an initial coarse extraction envelope; Phase 1 processing must clip features and report counts.

local_origin.selection_rule: Derive from the project-approved map origin near Grey's Monument and store the resolved values in the generated manifest.
